string.name: desc
string.value: Exceed speeds up your attacks and makes you more powerful, but also strains your body and decreases the amount of HP you absorb through Life Sap. When you reach the skill’s final stage, the attacks will change. Your Exceed stage will reset if you use another Exceed skill.
